name: OpenPromoter
description: OpenPromoter is open-source affiliate and referral program software for SaaS. It tracks referrals from Stripe, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy, checks for fraud and prepares partner payouts with 0% payout fees.
seoDescription: Open-source affiliate and referral software for SaaS. Self-host OpenPromoter on Dokploy with Postgres in a few clicks.
